newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen opening slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen opening slightly lower.

text.p: * Finnish shares seen opening slightly lower on Thursday after Wall Street fell on Wednesday. *Nokia seen opening near Wednesday's closing level around 362 markka following its nearly unchanged close in New York. *Volumes seen thin ahead of long midsummer weekend. *Overall sentiment cautious due to EMU uncertainty. *Neste seen suffering today from IVO CEO Marttinen's view that merger unlikely. *YIT seen gaining on positive home building permits number, brokers say.
